milestone: Resident byte gather through range/GKR on the producer's native owner, with original-MAC PCS closure
changes: Config::with_resident binds the original library/device/arena/reserve and the shared Mutex<Runtime>; second-owner creation from resident configuration is rejected
The range reader receives public geometry and the already-locked runtime, returns a sealed typed Buffer, and never receives FS challenges or correlations
Resident windows bypass host Reader/upload; evaluator releases its windows, canopy, children and Gram buffers while preserving W and retained source capacity
Shared guard aborts the common runtime on unfinished/error/unwind paths; no fallback. Successful finish leaves the runtime available for the next consumer
Work.native_shared distinguishes cumulative live-owner Stats from standalone closed-owner Stats

coverage.positive: Two D10 byte-range proofs with a retained original i16 source and a GPU byte-gather route on the same owner/W. Exact wire/transcript/forms/targets match CPU dense reference, and PCS opens the original MAC targets. Fake deferred driver/algebra, not CUDA execution.
coverage.traffic: H2D bytes unchanged across both proofs; no host Reader invocation, no second arena or W install. Allocation/release deltas balance, retained live capacity and W unchanged.
coverage.negative: Five cases: reader error, pending buffer, wrong kind, wrong length, changed reserve configuration. Every case stops the common runtime before root authentication; only 256 histogram rows consumed. Existing native reader/launch/fence failure regressions retained.
coverage.limitations: This connects the resident-window interface to the range/GKR prover, not the complete canonical producer replay scanner or three-response GPU runner. PCS in the reduced test remains CPU/ideal-MAC. Runtime Send relies on exclusive mutex ownership, process-local library lifetime and CUDA device reselection, not a claim of concurrent CUDA validation.

tests.earlier_failure: The unrelated CPU output-head iterator-exhaustion failure remains preserved in the nonlinear predecessor; not claimed fixed or rerun.
